image_description: A close-up shot of a dessert featuring a scoop of white ice cream (likely vanilla or berry-swirled) sitting atop a golden-brown pastry base. The ice cream is garnished with fresh raspberries, mint leaves, and a dusting of powdered sugar. A glossy glaze or syrup coats parts of the pastry and fruit. The background is blurred, showing hints of greenery.

The stem of the mint leaf at the top seems to emerge from the ice cream without a clear attachment point or physical logic, appearing to float slightly or merge unnaturally with the scoop's surface.
